reviews.text: This place is great and Vanessa is absolutely amazing 😻 …
Took my three dogs to get groomed today and they all looked so good! We worked with Paulina and she was so sweet and attentive! It was super easy to make appointments and get them all in at once!

Location is adorable! Groomers are amazing and friendly. I have a 12 yr old maltipoo who is no longer able to be groom at Petco due to her age more challenging.  I took her to Love on a leash, and my maltipoo was taken care of.

This was my first time taking my 3 dogs there and all I have to say is it was by far my favorite place excellent customer service.And all the groomers looked very friendly the dogs seem very content but I especially want to acknowledge Paulina she did an amazing job on my 2 doodles I will definitely be a regular also want to Thank jessica for all her help and information she was giving me. Thank you 😊
Paulina is an incredible groomer and pays such great attention to any pet she cares for. I couldn’t recommend love on a leash more!
My first time going here and I loved how Vanessa groomed them! 10/10 ◡̈
Tiger was very well groomed.  Staff is very accommodating and open.  Paulina gave Tiger an excellent cut, much thanks to her - A1 result.
Paulina is very friendly and easy to communicate with. She understands our needs and concerns, and delivers 100% what we asked for 😄👍 …

My first time at Love on a Leash and Paulina was exceptional with caring for my senior pomeranian Boba (13) and she has SUCH good taste!

He looked soo spiffy after the haircut (his tail is my favorite) and was impressed with how many different scissors Paulina used to make sure the haircut was even and accurate. We didn’t have a preference with any styled haircut so Paulina suggested a teddy bear haircut while maintaining some length and we loved it. We also went with the deluxe spa package with extra conditioner, which was well worth it because he has never felt *this* soft before!

Safe to say this will be our regular spot and main groomer from now on. Thank you Paulina 💗💞💓🩷

*First 3 photos are after our visit, last photo is before visiting.*
Samantha was great with my dog he is a rescue and she was very patient and slow with him. She did a beautiful job with his grooming and he left very happy worth the prices !

I got my dog groomed by Keyma from Love on a Leash.  It was my first time getting my dog groomed there and she understood the assignment. My mini golden doodle came out so adorable with bows and all🎀🐶. Keyma is knowledgeable about dogs and has nice energy and personality . I will recommend her and I definitely will be back for my dog’s next grooming session.
Sam is awesome. She’s very patient with my dog and he’s not the easiest. She’s slowly winning him over with each visit and we couldn’t be happier. Thanks Sam.
My Chanel loves Paulina!  She does great work on Chanel!  Everyone is friendly n professional!
Great customer service and haircut for our pups.
Very kind and easy to work with. I know my dog is in good hands when I bring him here.

First timer and everyone was so lovely ! Brought my Saint Bernard who needed some loving and they went over and beyond to take care of her ! Paulina was our groomer and she did awesome !!! My Honey girl came out so perfect !!!!

My dogs (and I) love Paulina at Love on a Leash.  She has been grooming my dogs for years and it's been great!  The dogs truly get excited when we pull into the parking lot.  Which is saying a lot.  When I get a new rescue, Paulina is very good about taking her time to win them over.  When I adopted my white shepherd mix (from the shelter), her fur was stained yellow.  Over the course of several months, Paulina was successful in getting her coat back to the beautiful white color.   For those considering Love on the Leash, please give Paulina a try.  She is truly amazing.  And please thoughtful and and tip the groomers.  :-)
W0W these people are the best ever! Barron has never looked so good! Thank you very very much

Our old groomer moved and was no longer available so we were in the process of trying to find a new one for our 14 year old dog. His face and body turned out great but his butt and tail, which were areas I specifically asked to focus on, were not. His butt was uneven (left cheek was shaved down, looked neat while right cheek still had a huge chunk of hair) and his tail looked untouched.

I didn’t realize how bad it was until we got home. I texted the salon back immediately and sent pictures.  They offered to fix it if I brought him back but we didn’t have time for that. After multiple back and forth with the manager, Paulina, the only resolution they continued to offer was 10% off of a future visit.

After this experience, there won’t be a future visit so that’s not much of a resolution.

It was a very disappointing experience and I would not recommend.
Wonderful job My Dog Blaze and I are so happy with his grooming Thanks A million

This place is absolutely awesome. After going to the same mobile groomer for four years, I never thought I’d switch but I needed a last-minute appointment and found this place randomly, and I’m so glad I did.
Jovan was professional, kind, and made the whole experience stress-free. Benji and Bella Love This Place.
Love Paulina. She's great with our dogs. We have been taking our dogs to her for years - she remembers every detail about our dogs. Not something you can expect from groomers in general.

Absolutely love my baby trim he looks amazing !!! My little Royal 🤍
I will definitely be coming back . I got exactly what I wanted …
Love on a Leash!!! Five Star service been coming here for years for my yorkie!!! He loves it here I love it here! Paulina is my go to groomer.

We just moved to the San Pedro area from echo park. So happy to have a groomer that meets our senior dog and young pups needs. Akeimas work is excellent! We get our dogs the full spa experience. Our dogs look fabulous and smell great. We have been there 3 times now and each service has been above and beyond our expectations.

After multiple failed attempts with other groomers due to my dog’s aggressive behavior, we finally found Paulina who truly cares. She took her time, stayed calm, and worked through the challenges without giving up. She worked through his mattes and knots.  The results were amazing and I couldn’t be happier!
They are always so welcoming since I’ve been coming and they give me exactly what I ask for even if I don’t go into detail I’m always satisfied!!!!!

Paulina did an amazing job with my dog Charlie who has had too many problems with other groomers in the past. Charlie has a tendency to be a bit aggressive when the clippers come out and she kept him calmer than most have tried. He had been without a grooming for a few months and she took him on and gave him a comfortable new lease on life and him and I couldn't be happier. Thank you!

My dog went to the Urgent Care vet 2 days after she visited Love on a Leash Grooming (for haircut, nail trim, the basics). She had rashes, scabs and a painful skin infection due to the shampoo, conditioner, or brush (cross-contamination) they used. My dog was whining and showing aggression when I touched her, it was that bad. The owner did not talk to me to resolve the issue afterwards, only another worker. I had asked to talk to them. Also, I had told the staff when dropping off that my dog has allergies to fragrances and has sensitive skin. The conditioner they used had fragrance listed. I ended up paying close to $300 at the vet for the minimal care, as the vet quoted me close to $2k to get more tests done. In the end, they refunded me the grooming fee via text, but I am not satisfied as my dog was in a lot of pain and I feel it is their fault for not checking ingredients or at least talking to me more about what to use on her. Their solution was to put hypoallergenic on her profile. Well why wasn't that done to begin with as I told them from the beginning? I feel this is negligence and unprofessional.

Hello there,
My puppy first time with Love on a Leash. I highly recommend, Samantha and staff very friendly and helpful.  Very clean and transparent. You can walk right in,  no waiting in your vehicle.  My pup is 14yrs young and they really did do an amazing job with her.  Thank you SO VERY much, highly appreciated 💕🐶💕
Super happy with service and comfortable leaving my pooch🩷 Ty! …
Very clean, open facility. Staff was very nice. And polite Paulina did a fabulous job with Ruby taking good care of my senior dog!
Loved our experience!!! We will be back!!
Keyma did such a great job with our little 1 year-old pomeranian, who suffers from luxating patella and is a tripawd. Will be coming back whenever in town!

Love on leash is top notch. The staff was so very friendly, helpful, and understanding when it came to our pet and our concern. It was our pets first time to the groomers and they made sure he felt comfortable and calm. Thank you Love on a Leash thank you Akeima for giving our pet an awesome first time. We'll see you guys again next time.

Love on a Leash has been a godsend for my senior dog. They take extra care when grooming him and really appreciate the fact that he is 16 yrs old and mostly blind and deaf. Today, he got stressed and peed while being dried. They immediately let me know via text, and said that they would be moving him to the kennel dryer which is much less stressful. It took longer but I appreciate it so much and didn’t mind at all. Thank you!!!! He looks so handsome in his little bow tie too!
Very friendly & care about pets.
Paulina is awesome and we would not let anyone else to groom our doggies

Took my Pomeranian to Love on the Leash for the first time. Samantha was very knowledgeable on how to groom a Pom unlike the other groomers I have used in the past. She did a wonderful job! I will be using Love on a Leash from now on.
Akeima was so great with my dogs sensitive skin, really liked the cut. So glad to have found this place

Amazing groomers! Friendly, professional, and wonderful with pets.  Highly recommend, this establishment is a cut above the rest.  My two goldens looked terrific and they were able to get them very clean and did a wonderful trim despite my boy being fussy.  A gem of a place!
First visit for my dog Sammy. I was extremely pleased with the staff, service and, more importantly, Sammy’s positive reaction to his experience. 🥰 …

We were referred to Love on a Leash because we had a difficult grooming and were told this place is the best.  When we arrived the groomer Giovan was very reassuring and it was obvious our QT was in great hands.  The facility itself is very clean and customer friendly for grooming.  The prices are very reasonable for the quality of the service provided.  The end result was a brand new dog, and a happy dog that was not nearly as stressed out on pickup as she has been with other places.  This store and their groomers are just awesome... and they had her done ahead of schedule with very clear communication.  After coming here once this is our new go to place for dog grooming.  They are located on PV Drive North just east of Western.
Paulina did an amazing job with my anxious pup, he looks great.

I Love Paulina. She does a great job grooming Lilah my 18 year old poodle that is blind and deaf.  I could go to a closer groomer nearer my house, but Paulina is wonderful and has been grooming Lilah for several years and can't imagine her being groomed by anyone else. Janet
We are extremely happy with the grooming and care that Tarcin received today and in August. I would highly recommend Love On a Leash Grooming.
Love On A Leash did a great job grooming our Havamalt today!  She looks just beautiful and everyone is so loving in the shop. I will continue our regular visits for sure.

This was my first time using their service and I absolutely loved it! I had my dog shampooed and trimmed, and the price was great for the wonderful job they did. He smells amazing, is super clean, and I love how they cut his hair—he looks like a handsome little doggy now, flea-free! The girls working there were so sweet and very helpful, answering all my questions about his dry skin condition, which I really appreciated. I will definitely be coming back again!
My husband and I took my Mother in laws dog here for some much needed TLC. They did an amazing job. The doggo even got a cute handkerchief tie at the end of his grooming. Highly recommend!
The wow factor when you see what they have.
I truly love this place.  My dog, Gianna loves going there.  Paulina is so attentive to Gianna.  She lets her groom her.   Paulina does such a great job.  She makes Gianna beautiful.

First time experience at this grooming place was great. Paulina did a great job on grooming my dog because she really took the time to listen to how I would like my dog groomed. A groomer that is patient and really listens to their customers really makes the experience that  much better!!
Pauleen did a great job! She was courteous and the prices are fair. Thank you!! 🙏 💕 …

I took my dog for grooming and Jovan did a fantastic job. I was very pleased with the service and also the new look of the store that has new owners. It is very clean and all staff are very friendly and courteous. I will definitely recommend Love on a Leash to my friends.
Its a great local place! The staff is impeccable and knowledgeable!

Summer always comes home so happy and clean she loves every time she goes in and that tells you when a dog is happy to go get groomed that they are treated very well! Summer is a frenchie and I always look forward to taking her in the staff always is welcoming and so sweet to Summer and us! If you are looking for an all around service love on a leash is it!!

Excellent service, very easy to schedule and great availability.
I appreciate the kindness and warmth towards my dog

We just wanted to say a big thank you for the amazing care and attention Samantha gave to Turtle and Paulina gave to Lilo!!  They came home looking and feeling their best, and we can tell they’re comfortable and happy in your hands. Your patience, skill, and genuine love for our furbabies truly shows.  I appreciate you listening to what we wanted and taking notes and saving it in your system.
Paulina is soooooo good! I highly recommend her.

So happy! I just adopted a 14 year old blind baby so I was very nervous having him groomed! ! He looks so amazing! Was able to get an appointment the same day. The really did a great job! Will be going back for sure! Staff were so incredibly nice. He smells great! Very happy with everything!
I love this place! They’re so kind to my dog and very helpful. I’ve been taking her there for years
Samantha has been my go to groomer for my doodle.. she does an amazing job & always leaves my girl Gigi looking good. Everyone here is really nice

Been going to Love on a Leash for years now. I must say our dogs always come home so clean, well groomed and pampered. And recently we have Paulina and Jovan grooming our dearest Cooper and Jayjay- appreciate how they show care and love for our fur babies! Thank you for all you do! ❤️

Paulina is the best! Staff there are sweet to our little one who is not as trusting or friendly to strangers. Paulina had our pup Maya in her trusting hands and had her first grooming ever. We keep coming back.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Paulina is a straight-up magician. Rosie went in looking like she’d been surviving off street tacos and heartbreak, and came out looking like a Beverly Hills housewife. 💅🐾

I swear, before the haircut, she looked like she was about to ask me for spare change. Now? She’s strutting around the house like she pays the mortgage. 😂

The updates after the appointment are chef’s kiss and the prices don’t make me cry—win-win.
Thank you Paulina for turning my crusty gremlin into a show dog. We stan. 👏

Blue came out so handsome and smelled so good & soft ❤️❤️🥰🥰🥰🥰.
Definitely will be coming back!!!! …
Paulina is great! She’s great with the dogs and our poodles always looks spectacular when I pick them up!

Exceptional Grooming & Care – SoFy’s Best Spa Day Yet!

I took my English Cocker Spaniel, SoFy, to Love on a Leash, and it was hands down the best grooming experience we’ve ever had. From the warm welcome to the exceptional care, everything exceeded my expectations.

What truly sets them apart is that they do not offer hand stripping as a set service but they’re capable to do so— a traditional grooming technique that’s hard to find in LA and so important for maintaining the proper coat of certain breeds like SoFy. Not many places provide this level of specialized care, and it shows in the quality of their work.

The groomers treated SoFy like family, taking the time to make her feel safe and relaxed. She came out looking absolutely beautiful — her coat was clean, healthy, and perfectly styled. I could tell she was comfortable and well cared for the entire time.

Love on a Leash doesn’t just groom pets — they genuinely love them. This is now our go-to place. Highly, highly recommend!

I have been taking my dogs to Love on a Leash for a year. I am always very pleased with the grooming and deshedding that my dogs get. Today we had Akeima for the first time and the dogs were so adorable with matching neck scarves and bows. We just loved the service she gave to our puppy girls.

We have been bringing our dog to Love on a Leash ever since we moved to the area. We always have such a great experience and our dog looks amazing every time! Paulina is excellent. Highly recommend Love on a Leash!

Paula-is an amazing groomer. She is trustworthy, she reliable, and the service you get is the reason we keep coming back.
Our lovely cockpoo, Khloe is blind. But Paula makes sure that Khloe feels comfortable, safe, and gives her the best puppy spa. She always comes out look beautiful. Definitely recommend.
Paulina did an amazing job with our Great Dane and maltipoo. They both got groomed and look fabulous. I was so impressed with her work that I scheduled a grooming appointment right then and there.
I love this place!! They do a great job... my god always comes out looking fresh
The groomers at Love on a Leash were amazing. Super patient, friendly and compassionate. I will definitely be going back.

We've tried a couple places before we found Love on a Leash. Despite my husky's separation anxiety, he doesn't cry when I drop him off which was the biggest win for us.
His new groomer Akeima is very sweet and has him glowing and softer than ever.
Prices are reasonable for how much hair this guy has.
I haven't bought any supplies, but the store is very clean and the staff are always kind.
Paulina is a fantastic groomer, among the best!

Paulina was amazing. She took the time to explain to a first-grooming dog dad how she would approach dealing with a nervous pup and work with her to make the experience comfortable. Paulina gave my pup a beautiful haircut and put a smile on her face! Will definitely take my pup back here and request Paulina once again.
Always friendly and dogs enjoy their time there

We have been going to Love on a Leash for grooming for about a year, since we moved to the area, and we LOVE it! Our dog always comes out looking and smelling amazing, and they seem to really care. Jovan in particular is a saint amongst men. He’s gentle and kind, meticulous, and so good with my temperamental, spicy Pomeranian. We are customers for life.

First time to Love on a Leash and had a great experience. The staff are friendly and clearly love the dogs. Haircut and all the other grooming bits and pieces turned out great and now we have a nice smelling dog again! Will be back.

This place is really great! I recently took my two small dogs here for the first time, and I am very impressed with their care and service. Samantha and Pauline did an incredible job on my senior mini schnauzer and shihtzu. They even had a blueberry facial which smells amazing! I look forward to my next appointment here and I love the spa add-ons they offer :-)
We brought our dog in for some grooming today and I must say they did an excellent job, keep up the good work
Just had our Sofie groomed and couldn't be happier.  The staff is very caring and attentive to our questions and concerns.  Service was excellent.
Thank you so much to Jovan at Love on A Leash! First time taking my dog Chuy to the groomer and he did a great job.

While at the dog park someone oveheard me mentioning I needed to get my pups groomed. She mentioned Love on a leash, which we had been looking at during thier remodel. We went right from the park to Love on a leash. We were so excited at how welcoming the staff was. They fit us in right away. Love the shop, the staff , and the care they gave our babies. Loki and Thor came home happy and gorgeous. Don't miss out give them a visit!.

Beautiful grooming, Pauline,
with all the beautiful animals and the dogs
. Love you. and the boss really appreciates you as an employer
Rishon
Love on a leash and a grand opening of all the beautiful things in the store and all natural food and come and join and get your doggy groom and join the family
Excellent service,  my grandpup was very happy and she came out super cute 😍 …

I’m so happy I found this grooming shop. My 10-month-old standard poodle had been turned away from a previous groomer because he’s very wiggly and tends to do an alligator roll during grooming. I was nervous we’d run into the same issue again, but the team here was incredibly patient and understanding. After being turned away, I tried to groom him myself with clippers, and he came out botched. They really had their work cut out for them trying to even everything out, and they absolutely nailed it. He looks and smells amazing!

Thank You
Whitney
For doing a excellent job Grooming
Mr. EKKO 🐶 …

The staff and groomers are so professional and do a great job.. luv the reminders and how well they communicate.  May my babies always look so amazing after they’re done.  Thank you for all that you do!

Jovan is magical. He made our sweet pup look gorgeous and took so much time with her. I am very happy with the customer service, excellent communication, and overall care by Love on A Leash! Highly recommend

I found love on a leash about 6 months ago and I love them! I love how they have a text system for reminders if you haven't made an appointment or text you when it is time to pick up your pet. The staff is always so nice and leave my pups looking and smelling so fresh!
Absolute lovely experience! Very clean, welcoming, intimate enviornment. Thank you Sam for doing such an amazing job. Highly recommended. Will definitely be a returning client. 🐶🐾🤍😊 …
Paulina did a great job on Toffee. She took the time to listen what I want and delivered. We will be back!

They do a great job every time. They keep great notes so I literally just drop them off and say “same thing as last time.” Price is fair, and they text to remind you to make an appointment. What more could you ask for?
Great work with my senior, blind dog. Thank you so much!!

They are the best! It’s easy to get an appointment,  they are super friendly( my dogs love them, I have a standard poodle and maltipoo) and the quality of grooming is amazing 🤩! So happy I found them! …

They have a way that calms my Madeline (Tilly) so they’re able to do their magic… she looks adorable. Even the grow out looks great. Other groomers I’ve tried in the past she panicked so bad I had to make another appt.she was shaking so bad. I love them all at “Love On A Leash”
Very happy with their lovely services and how they handle my dog
Always a pleasure. My dog always looks his best after a grooming. 5*****
Excellent service very friendly very professional loving caring groomers 10 out of 10 recommended
They are the most amazing caring groomers in all I ever meet I truly trust love and adore I wouldnt trust my pets with anyone but these guys! Love you guys!!
